paragraphs: See the entries R' Yehudah ben Beteira, R' Yehoshua ben Beteira and R' Yochanan ben Beteira.[^1]

notes.text: The three references are lexical pointers, without links to identified people. The heading Beteira supplies the local context for the abbreviation B-B as ben Beteira. Each abbreviated title remains R'; no named passage has been supplied here to establish a fuller title for these occurrences. Earlier English and model judgments remain archived.
